description: This file defines the MessageOnlyLogFilter class, a filter implementing the LogNode interface to pass along only log messages without metadata, used for simplified on-screen logging.

classes.name: MessageOnlyLogFilter
classes.description: A log filter that passes only message strings to the next LogNode in the chain, omitting metadata.

methods.name: MessageOnlyLogFilter
methods.description: Constructor that takes a LogNode to chain the filter.

methods.name: println
methods.description: Filters log messages to pass only the message text to the next LogNode.

methods.name: getNext
methods.description: Returns the next LogNode in the chain.

methods.name: setNext
methods.description: Sets the next LogNode in the chain.
